github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use conventional commit format: type(scope): description.
Use imperative mood: 'Add feature' not 'Added feature'.
Use types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, chore, ci.
Include scope when relevant (e.g., api, ui, auth).
For additional details, use a well-structured body section, for minimal changes is not necessary to add more details, with the description should be enough, take your own criteria on it.
Always make all the commit text on english.

Understand the context, if i make a change on page.tsx, the scope should not be just (page), this is a Next.js 15 project, check the folders above the file, such as if i make a change con input.tsx but its inside components folder, determinate whether add just (components) or the specific component name such as (input), everything depends on the changes and the context.
